parsed.rationale: Both participating records are SwiftUI `App`-conformance `body` computed properties serving as standalone entry points for component preview/demo targets, not shared production logic. The file `Shared/WXUI/Examples/WXUISampleApp/Sources/WXUISampleApp.swift` resides under the `Examples/` directory tree, which is a canonical sample-app location per the decision rules — the `is_sample_app` metadata flag notwithstanding. Similarly, `Shared/PlayerHeaderView/PlayerHeaderViewApp/PlayerHeaderViewApp.swift` is a per-component app harness (`PlayerHeaderViewApp`), not a reusable production type. The structural match is purely boilerplate coincidence: every SwiftUI `App` entry point with a single `WindowGroup` scene will produce an identical `body` shape at line 15. Extracting or unifying these would couple unrelated demo targets to each other without any production benefit.
